Transform の回転に、1 秒でこれだけ足します (X → Y → Z の: Adds this much to the Transform's rotation every second (Euler angles, X → Y → Z)
透視: 遠くの物ほど小さく見える / 平行投影: 遠くても同じ大きさ (図面や: Perspective: farther things look smaller / Orthographic: the same size at any distance (drawings, 2D-style games)
透視のとき。画面の縦に見える角度: Perspective only. The vertical angle seen on screen
平行投影のとき。画面の縦に映る長さの半分: Orthographic only. Half the height of what is seen on screen
これより近い物は映りません: Nothing nearer than this is seen
これより遠い物は映りません (近い面より遠く): Nothing farther than this is seen (beyond the near plane)
外すと、ゲームの設定の「背景の色」で塗ります: When off, the game settings' Background color fills the picture
「自分の背景の色を使う」のとき: When "Use its own background color" is on
平行光: 太陽のように全体へ同じ向きで (位置は関係ない) / 点光源: 電球の: Directional: one direction everywhere, like the sun (its position does not matter) / Point: all around, like a bulb / Spot: inside a cone, like a flashlight
点光源とスポット。ここで光が 0 になります: Point and spot. The light fades to nothing here
スポットのとき。光の広がりの全体の角度: Spot only. The whole angle the light spreads over
ゲームの設定の「最初のカメラ」が選ばれていません。カメラの部品を付けたエンティテ: No Starting camera is chosen in the game settings. Choose an entity with a Camera component and its view shows here.
「最初のカメラ」のエンティティがシーンにありません (消されたかもしれません)。: The Starting camera's entity is not in the scene (it may have been deleted). Choose it again in the game settings.
「{}」にカメラの部品がありません (Transform も要ります)。インスペ: "{}" has no Camera component (it needs a Transform too). Add a Camera with "Add component" in the Inspector.
カメラの「{}」が有効ではありません。有効にすると、そこから見た絵が映ります。: The camera "{}" is not active. Make it active and its view shows here.
描いた物 {} / {} (カメラの外は描かない): Drawn {} / {} (things outside the camera are skipped)
Play の間、この秒数ごとにゲームのカメラを次のカメラ (階層の順) に切り替: While playing, switches the game's camera to the next camera (in Hierarchy order) every this many seconds

上を向いた面に当たる光 (空の明るさ): The light on faces turned up (the sky)
下を向いた面に当たる光 (地面からの照り返し): The light on faces turned down (bounced off the ground)
光の影を床と物に落とす (光の部品の「影を落とす」に従う。光の部品が無いときは上: Cast shadows on the floor and objects (as each light's Cast shadows says; from above when there are no lights. Click to switch)
カメラ・光・床・箱が置いてある 3D のゲーム。: A 3D game with a camera, a light, a floor and a box in place.
